## Science 1991 – The beginning of EPI explosion

![Science 1991 – The beginning of EPI explosion.](images/science-1991-the-beginning-of-epi-explosion.png){#fig-ch18-science-1991-the-beginning-of-epi-explosion}

Notice that we have more coil measurements, I, than we have unknown substrate values, p.  If we know the coil sensitivities, we can solve this set of linear equations.
